description_expanded: OverviewBeautiful Home at the Front of Seacrest- 3 Bikes - Lagoon Pool -Private Beach- 5 Minute Walk `Catch of the Day`The Space Catch of the Day – Charming Beach Cottage with Pool & Beach Access! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Spacious & Luxurious Master Suite & Bath – Relax in comfort & style Loft Room with 2 Connecting Balconies – Perfect for extra space & coastal views Pool & Beach Access with Free Shuttle Pick-Up – Effortless trips to the sand & surf 3 Free Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & local hotspots Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern stainless steel appliances & open layout New Gas Grill – Perfect for vacation cookouts 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon-Style Pool – Largest resort-style pool on 30A Short Walk to Shops & Restaurants – Easy access to Seacrest Towne Centre Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 1 Vehicle – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Catch of the DayCatch of the Day is a simple, beautiful beach styled house with 3BR + Loft and 3 baths. The luxury cottage-like house is expertly decorated and is only a five-minute walk to the beach, and a one-minute walk to the pools. The outside look of this house really gives you the inside satisfaction of being at the beach yet feeling at home. It’s not too big yet not too small, with surrounding trees and landscaping that just draws you in and welcomes you with warmth. There is also a brand-new gas grill for guest use!The living space and dining area intertwine perfectly and provide a very open and comfortable feel. The kitchen is spacious, and complete with well-maintained steel appliances. There is one queen bedroom on the first level, with an adjacent bathroom. The extravagantly luxurious master bedroom, and master bath are on the second floor. The 3rd bedroom with a king bed and adjacent bathroom are on the second floor as well. The third floor has a loft most suitable for children but can accommodate any age. There are 2 twin beds with twin trundles on the third floor.Located in Seacrest, you as a guest can enjoy the 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon style pool, the largest along 30A. The tram (meant for owners and guests) can also carry you to the beach access when you’re ready to enjoy the pure white sand of the Gulf of Mexico.Don't feel like cooking? There are several restaurants within walking distance including the newly completed open huts with shops, and restaurants are surrounded by the grass-covered commons area of the Towne Centre. Each brightly colored, gabled unit is easily identified and inviting for both regular customers and newcomers alike. From sunglasses to souvenirs, hop into one of these kiosks to find just the right thing.Come stay with us to enjoy all the great activities and natural beauty this area has to offer!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):Master Bedroom: King Bed; Private Spaciously Luxurious Master BathGuest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed; Adjacent Full BathroomGuest Bedroom 2: King Bed; Adjacent Full BathroomLoft Room: 4 Twin BedsAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
